tasks.label: Preview report card
tasks.detail: Build the report card into docs/ and serve it on port 8765
tasks.command: mkdir -p data && { [ -s data/state.jsonl ] || curl -sfLo data/state.jsonl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmelahman/pkglint/site/data/state.jsonl; } && go run ./site -maintainer Jamison -since-days 90 -top 500 -budget 200 -state data/state.jsonl -out docs && python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory docs
